prior_findings_resolution.prior_problem: PATH rustc identity did not select the compiler actually instructed to Cargo.
prior_findings_resolution.resolution: compiler_environment selects explicit RUSTC or PATH rustc, preserves rustup proxy invocation basename, verifies executable, disables both wrappers with explicit empty overrides, and supplies one environment to verbose identity queries and actual build. Invocation, resolved executable bytes and reported version are recorded before/after. Legacy argv is unchanged.

prior_findings_resolution.prior_problem: An equal-byte symlink at the crates inventory root was accepted.
prior_findings_resolution.resolution: source_snapshot lstat-checks the crates inventory root as a directory before traversal. The independent root-symlink control now rejects it; regular-file symlink rejection and exact tracked/disk inventory remain.

prior_findings_resolution.prior_problem: A shared target can reuse workspace outputs from another worktree; a target-only override still allows configured build.build-dir to share intermediates.
prior_findings_resolution.resolution: Each new evidence output owns an initially absent cargo-target. Both CARGO_TARGET_DIR and CARGO_BUILD_BUILD_DIR are set to that private path, are recorded, and override inherited values. The resolved product is required to remain inside the private target. The control verifies shared content unchanged and rejects a foreign artifact.

accepted_scope: Full committed crate/Cargo blob bytes and exact current inventory, including ignored extras, are compared before/after and tied to a full source commit/tree and manifest hash.
The selected compiler invocation and Cargo tool identity are compared before/after. Receipt wording correctly distinguishes proxy bytes/reported version from hermetic compiler certification.
Production codecortex target, requested feature set, non-test profile, source manifest/main paths, exactly one artifact, private-target location, copied binary and copy hash are bound.
Both final and intermediate Cargo artifacts are directed into one fresh output-owned target without changing the existing command vector.
Failed and source-mutating builds preserve raw logs, emit failure information and cannot produce a successful receipt. An existing evidence directory cannot be overwritten.

schema_version 1 and legacy receipt fields and build_command remain compatible with the existing Rust benchmark_adapters receipt consumer; new identity fields are additive. Current CI uses fresh output paths.
compatibility_qualification: Arbitrary callers that previously precreated --output-dir must choose a fresh directory. Compiler selection is now deliberately pinned by explicit RUSTC or PATH rustc, with wrappers disabled; the receipt records that policy.

independent_validation.fixture_kind: Disposable synthetic Git source and Python tool executables. No Rust compiler, production build or shared target binary was run.

boundary: This is read-only implementation review plus independent Python controls, accepted for the source/compiler/artifact receipt scope. It does not certify an actual offline product build, runtime behavior, all build inputs/dependency trust, or whole P7-017 acceptance.
